title: Leviathan
text: Leviathan Primordial world boss The Leviathan is a colossal underwater boss that rules over the Devouring Depths of the Arcadian Sea. It is one of the seven Major World Bosses, and spawns three times a week at 14:00 o'clock server time on Monday, Wednesday and Saturday. The Leviathan spawns Seabugs. A lot of Seabugs. Crowd Controling and killing them fast is crucial for the crew not to get killed by them. Wing attack. Getting too close to the wings pushes you away and deals damage. Pull. The Leviathan with suck in players in a certain area around it once it hits a certain phase.. Healing. The Leviathan has a constant regeneration durin his moving phases and none in the tank phases. Leviathan's Authority. The Leviathan will only fight in its area, weaken anyone being inflicted with Trauma and will shove away anything in its way (Leviathan's AuthorityBuffLeviathan's AuthorityTerrifies nearby targets afflicted with the Rebirth Trauma debuff, preventing them from engaging in a normal battle.The Leviathan generates periodic waves that destroy nearby docks and shove nearby ships and individuals.The Leviathan will flee the battle if it loses sight of its enemies or it moves outside of its territory.). Leviathan's Fury. The Levathan summons Storms lifting ships off the ocean and throwing them around like toys (Leviathan's FuryDebuffLeviathan's FurySummons a terrible storm that pushes ships away and deals damage to all targets within range.). Leviathan's Fear. Mounts and Pets near the Leviathan get the Leviathan's FearDebuffLeviathan's FearCauses your pet to sense the Leviathan's nearness, making it too terrified to act.Duration: 30sec Debuff. Skills of the Leviathan Basic Leviathan's Jump Range: 0-500 m Instant [Monster Skill] The Leviathan destroys nearby drydocks. Basic Leviathan's Fury Range: 0-140 m Instant 1min Cooldown The Leviathan dives deep, creating a large whirlpool. File:Unknown item.png Basic Leviathan's Jump Instant 30sec Cooldown The leviathan makes an impressive jump out of the water. Basic Ultrasonic Waves Range: 0-150 m Instant 30sec Cooldown The Leviathan produces Ultrasonic Waves. Tips Bring as many people as you can on the first attempts, because the fight takes some learning. Kill the adds fast and stay clear of the orbs. The fight

The fight takes place in the water. Everyone fights using the ships cannons, since the Leviathan is imune to any damage but Siege Damage. Every cannon has its own part in the fight and only by using them right one will be able to kill the Leviathan.

Tips

  • Bring as many people as you can on the first attempts, because the fight takes some learning.
  • Kill the adds fast and stay clear of the orbs.
